review.verdict: Fails: the left-side 'fist stopped short by the shield' beat is lost to a cheering pose far from a near-invisible shield, and the dark blueprint/split-screen treatment repeats several recent pieces, pulling the average below the 3.5 bar.
revisionNotes: Move person1 much closer to the bubble (anchor ~y:0.55 instead of 0.8) and swap pose 'cheer' for a clenched fist reaching upward — right now there's a big empty gap between the figure and the bubble, so the shield isn't visibly stopping anything.

Scale up the shield (currently 0.4) and move it to sit flush on the bubble's front face instead of tucked into the bottom-right tail corner — at this size and position it's nearly invisible and the core 'shield protects the chatbot' joke doesn't register.
The antenna icon reads as an ambiguous crosshair/plus mark rather than a robot ear — redesign it or drop it so the bubble clearly signals 'AI chatbot'.
Reposition the '-$20B' label to sit directly beside the shortened yellow bar instead of floating in the dead space between the person and the chart, so it reads as the chart's data point.

Novelty: dark blueprint grid + left/right split composition closely echoes several recent pieces (the shield/door blueprint, the CALM piece, the PLEDGE piece) — try a different background treatment or an asymmetric layout.
Align the erasing-hand so it grips the top-right corner of the shortened/highlighted bar itself, not the chart frame's corner, to make the erase action unambiguous.

warnings: "droplabel" (label) was moved 0 px, -1 px to stay inside the safe area

review.verdict: The chart half (hand erasing a bar down to a dashed ghost line, -$20B) reads clearly, but the left half's gag - a shield stopping an angry fist - is lost in an overlap where shield and fist fuse into a confusing lump. Fails clarity/polish; not ready to publish.
revisionNotes: Shield is hidden behind the fist at the bubble-person junction; the shapes fuse into a confusing lump that reads as a fist-shaped hat on the person's head, not 'shield blocks fist'. Draw shield in front of the fist and give it its own fill/stroke contrast against the navy bg so its outline pops.
Increase the gap between 'fist' and 'shield' anchors (offsets -6 and -15 nearly collide) so there's visible negative space showing the fist stopped just short of the bubble, per the brief.
Shield (scale 1.15, bubble-bottom offset -15) overlaps person1's head (offset -6 from person top); separate these anchors vertically so shield, fist, and head don't all converge on one spot.

Ghostline dashed marker floats above the chart frame instead of aligning with the top of the shortened third bar; drop it to sit just above bar 3's old height so the before/after erase logic is tighter.
Blueprint navy palette plus a shield icon repeats vocabulary already used twice in the recent set (a shield/eye/door piece, a navy bar-chart piece); consider a different accent motif or palette.
After fixing the shield/fist overlap, confirm the left vignette alone reads as 'shield protects chatbot from an angry fist' in under 3 seconds without the chart half for context.

review.verdict: Passes, barely: the revenue-chart half lands instantly, but the floating fist sits disconnected between the bubble and the person with no arm linking it, muddying the 'stopped short' beat, and the blue blueprint two-panel format is heavily repeated from recent pieces.
revisionNotes: Reconnect the fist to the raised arm: either attach a forearm/sleeve shape running from person1's shoulder up to the fist, or shorten the offset (e.g. -40 instead of -90) so it reads as 'reaching toward the bubble' rather than a stray glove floating in empty blueprint grid.

Tighten the left column: person1, fist, and bubble are three isolated shapes stacked with large gaps (y 0.18 / ~0.37 / 0.86). Bring person1 up toward y 0.65-0.7 so the whole left vignette reads as one cluster at a glance.

Vary the format from recent output: blue blueprint grid plus a left/right two-concept split has appeared in at least four of the last eight pieces (RISK/AI, TOO LATE, CALM, PLEDGE). Try a different panel arrangement or accent palette to stand out.
Keep the chart side as-is — erasing hand, dotted ghost line, and -$20B label read instantly and land the second half of the joke cleanly.
